items.es: How can I help you?

items.es: I'll be right with you.
items.nota: Dito quando o atendente ainda está ocupado.

I'd like to make a complaint.

items.es: I'll look into it right away.

I understand your situation.

I still haven't received my order.
We'll send you a new one free of charge.
Could you fill out this form?
items.nota: Nos EUA: "fill out". No Reino Unido: "fill in".

items.es: I'm sorry about what happened.
Our business hours are nine to six.
items.pt: O horário de atendimento é das nove às seis.

items.es: We serve customers on a first-come, first-served basis.
items.nota: Expressão fixa: quem chega primeiro é atendido primeiro.

items.es: Thank you for your patience.
